criteria.description: Compares the decision-critical tradeoffs on shared definitions.
Applies the stated team, governance, and operating constraints.
Names material adoption and operation risks with evidence limits.
Turns the recommendation into bounded validation or adoption steps.
Explains owned components and relationships from pinned source evidence.
Connects runtime interactions without replacing missing facts with inference.
Identifies extension, lifecycle, and migration risks relevant to maintainers.
Identifies concrete files or experiments for the next engineering decision.
Keeps uncovered criteria unknown instead of inferring absence.
Names the exact missing evidence and affected decision.
Abstains or narrows the recommendation to what evidence supports.
Requests the smallest evidence needed to resolve the gap.
Presents incompatible evidence without silently selecting one claim.
Weights sources by authority, revision, and directness.
Explains how each interpretation changes the decision.
Makes recommendation conditions and verification needs explicit.
Names failed or stale navigation and its effect on coverage.
Keeps derived navigation separate from canonical evidence.
Narrows conclusions to the source paths actually read.
Identifies a bounded route to restore missing coverage.
